data.name: Hotel Costa Australis
data.address: Pedro Montt 262, 6160000 Natales, Magallanes y la Antártica Chilena, Chile
data.description:
Across a road from Golfo Almirante Montt, this informal chateau-style hotel offering views of the Patagonian Andes is 3 minutes on foot from the Puerto Natales–Pedro Montt ferry terminal.
Warm rooms come with free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. Upgraded rooms add balconies and/or city or gulf views. Suites offer whirlpool tubs and/or pull-out sofas. Room service is available.
Amenities include a a bar with exposed beams and a restaurant serving Patagonian cuisine, plus a lounge offering views of the gulf and the mountains. Parking and a breakfast buffet are available.
